column1: # SOURCES — every external input the pipeline needs, and where to obtain it.
# Reproducibility model: this git repository provides the code (reproduce_paper.sh + src/).
# The data are NOT in git; download the two FigShare deposits and the genome files below,
# extract/place them as indicated, then run ./reproduce_paper.sh (see README.md).
#   this-study/32593647   this study (van Zalen et al.)     FigShare  doi:10.17044/scilifelab.32593647
#          -> expression matrices, DESeq2 objects + DE tables, ComPlEx co-expression
#             network output, per-gene annotation, orthology tables, sample metadata,
#             and this study's own inputs (CHS3 PAV, pine drought physiology).
#   Kalman/28737623  Kalman et al. (spruce/pine popgen + genomes)  FigShare  doi:10.17044/scilifelab.28737623
#          -> population-genomic selection/GWAS gene sets, Hi-C TAD / compartment data,
#             and the genome CDS/protein/repeat/annotation files (placed under DATA_ROOT).
#          NOTE: files in the Kalman deposit are gzipped. gunzip them on placement into the repo, since the
#             pipeline reads the UNCOMPRESSED filenames — e.g. Orthogroups/Orthogroups.tsv[.gz],
#   ENA-assembly  raw genome assemblies: Norway spruce Picab02 = ENA GCA_964035815.1;
#          Scots pine Pinsy01 = ENA GCA_965112685.1. ENA umbrella project PRJEB88492. Both
#          assemblies are PUBLIC, so the genome files are obtainable from ENA even while the
#          Kalman FigShare deposit remains embargoed (the popgen/epigenetics inputs are Kalman-only).
#   bioRxiv  Rodriguez et al. wood-formation cliques  bioRxiv doi:10.1101/2025.06.28.661522
# NOTE (verify before release): the this-study/32593647 vs Kalman/28737623 split below is my best mapping; please
# confirm which deposit each archive actually lives in, since only you control the deposits.
# ── this-study/32593647 this study — expression, DE, network, annotation, orthology, metadata ──────────────
